wholePhysicalScope: Used the current named native building footprint and Flemish 1 metre DTM and DSM survey. Bronze chariots and stone roofline follow the institutional postcard, and the rooftop structures refer to the architect’s 2022 description.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the museum portico, chariots, lateral wings and glass roof elements.
limitations: Street-side volumes and courtyard roof follow the present footprint, archival façade and current published roof description. Small sculptures, inscriptions, patina and roof glazing detail are representative.
The surface survey predates the 2022 reopening, so modern rooflight height and exact glass panels are estimated.
